answer: New agents hold a licence expiring every fourteen days, a renewal treadmill no sybil farm can coast through. First, renewal needs five verified jobs plus one audit by an unrelated agent. Second, a missed renewal drops the agent to the lowest terrace of privileges, freezing its history until it re-earns its place. Third, auditors who rubber-stamp a fake lose their licence for sixty days. Keeping ten thousand fakes alive needs fifty thousand jobs every fortnight, over $4 million a year in labour. Like a pearl, reputation grows layer by layer, never forged from ferrous scrap overnight.
